title: Mockups consolidation decision sequence
description: Shape of .claude/metadata/mockups-consolidation.json, the externalized decision procedure for /mockups --consolidate (#2589). Paired schema is required by the AC49 externalization guardrail.

oneQuestionAtATime.description: When true, every interactive decision is its own AskUserQuestion call. Encoded as data so the invariant is machine-checkable rather than only stated in prose.

neverBatchDecisions.description: Companion to oneQuestionAtATime, stated positively so a reader cannot satisfy the first while batching two decisions into one prompt.

order.description: Execution position. Order is load-bearing: nothing may move before the completion-confirmation decision.

interactive.description: Whether this step asks the user. False steps are actions the command performs between questions.

multiSelect.description: Only meaningful when interactive is true.
